hotlinkElementId.description: The hotlink element which contains the element (ACAPI_Hotlink_GetContainingHotlinkGuid).

hotlinkInstanceId.description: The hotlink instance the element belongs to (ACAPI_Hotlink_GetHotLinkOwner).

HotlinkOwnersOfElementOrError.description: The hotlink an element comes from, or an error.

PossibleStringValues.description: The possible string values of a GDL parameter.

PossibleNumericValues.description: The possible numeric values of a GDL parameter.

value.description: The numeric value. Present for all flags except 'Step', which instead carries stepBegin/stepValue.

stepBegin.description: Only present when flag is 'Step': the value is stepBegin + n*stepValue for n >= 0.

stepValue.description: Only present when flag is 'Step' - see stepBegin.

description.description: The description of the value.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

displayName.description: The display name of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

value.description: The value of the parameter. For an array parameter it is a flat list of all items row by row: dimension1 rows of dimension2 items each. SetGDLParametersOfElements accepts the same flat list back.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

isLocked.description: The parameter is locked; i.e. the user cannot modify it

canHaveCustomValue.description: The parameter can have a custom value.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter (API_AddParType.arrayDescriptions), one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

index1.description: Optional 1-based first index for changing a single item of an array parameter. Only valid for array parameters and only together with a single (non-list) value.

index2.description: Optional 1-based second index for changing a single item of a two-dimensional array parameter. Only valid together with index1. Defaults to 1.

value.description: The new value of the parameter, in the unit GetGDLParametersOfElements reports it in (Angle parameters in radians). For array parameters provide a list of values for one-dimensional arrays (e.g. [1, 2, 3]) or a list of lists for two-dimensional arrays (e.g. [[11, 12], [21, 22]]); the list must contain exactly as many values as the parameter has items, resizing an array parameter is not supported. A two-dimensional array can also be given as a flat list of all its dimension1 x dimension2 items row by row, the layout GetGDLParametersOfElements returns. Alternatively provide index1 (and optionally index2) together with a single value to change one item of the array. Within one command call whole-array (list) values are applied after all single-value changes.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

index1.description: Optional 1-based first index for changing a single item of an array parameter. Only valid for array parameters and only together with a single (non-list) value.

index2.description: Optional 1-based second index for changing a single item of a two-dimensional array parameter. Only valid together with index1. Defaults to 1.

value.description: The new value of the parameter, in the unit GetGDLParametersOfElements reports it in (Angle parameters in radians). For array parameters provide a list of values for one-dimensional arrays (e.g. [1, 2, 3]) or a list of lists for two-dimensional arrays (e.g. [[11, 12], [21, 22]]); the list must contain exactly as many values as the parameter has items, resizing an array parameter is not supported. A two-dimensional array can also be given as a flat list of all its dimension1 x dimension2 items row by row, the layout GetGDLParametersOfElements returns. Alternatively provide index1 (and optionally index2) together with a single value to change one item of the array. Within one command call whole-array (list) values are applied after all single-value changes.

vertexIds.description: Counterclockwise outer-loop vertex indices for this face.

filled.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to create only this loop's edges (a wireframe outline, e.g. a bare rectangle with no surface fill) without an actual face - holes/surfaceId are ignored in that case, since there is no fill for them to apply to.

holes.description: Optional hole loops cut out of this face, each a clockwise list of vertex indices.

surfaceId.description: Optional per-face surface (render material) override. Uses the Morph's default surface when omitted. Ignored during creation in Archicad 25.

coordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the leveling subline of the mesh.

CurtainWallPattern.description: The column (primary) or row (secondary) pattern of a curtain wall segment: the sizes of the columns/rows of one pattern unit and how the unit is repeated along the segment.

sizes.description: The sizes (widths of the columns or heights of the rows) of the pattern unit in meters, in order from the start of the segment or from the bottom. The unit is repeated to fill the segment.

flexibleIndices.description: Zero-based indices of the columns/rows of the pattern unit that 'BestDivision' may stretch. When omitted, all of them are flexible. Ignored by 'FixedSizes'.

CurtainWallPatternCell.description: The panel and frame classes of one cell of the pattern unit of a curtain wall segment. Panel classes are numbered as Archicad numbers them: 0 is no panel (the cell is left empty), 1 is the first panel class of the curtain wall (as listed in the Curtain Wall Settings, from the favorite or the tool defaults), 2 the second and so on. Frame classes: 0 is no frame (the cell is merged with its neighbour), 1 the Division frame, 2 the Corner frame, 3 the Boundary frame, 4 the first custom frame class of the curtain wall, 5 the second and so on. Fields not given keep the default assignment of the cell.

columnIndex.description: Zero-based column of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the start of the segment.

rowIndex.description: Zero-based row of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the bottom.

panelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the cell. 0 leaves the cell without a panel (Archicad keeps a hidden 'deleted panel' subelement there). With a crossing frame it is the class of the left (or lower) half; see rightPanelClassIndex for the other half.

rightPanelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the right (or upper) half of a cell with a crossing frame. Defaults to panelClassIndex.

leftFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the left edge of the cell (the grid line at the start of the column).

bottomFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the bottom edge of the cell (the grid line at the bottom of the row).

crossingFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the diagonal frame of the cell. Only used when crossingFrameType is not 'None'.

height.description: Only used for the Rectangular type.

LinkToSettings.description: Mode of linking an element to its home story.

homeStoryDifference.description: Difference of the home story from the current story.

newCreationMode.description: Controls home-story selection during element creation. If true, homeStoryDifference selects the home story relative to the current story and the element's absolute floor index is ignored. If false, the absolute floor index is used and Archicad fills homeStoryDifference. This is a creation instruction, not a persistent linking mode.

CoverFillOrientation.description: Orientation/distortion of the floor plan cover fill.

origo.description: Origin of the fill relative to the project origin.

matrix00.description: X component of the primary distortion (direction) vector - the cosine of the fill angle, if not distorted.

matrix10.description: Y component of the primary distortion (direction) vector - the sine of the fill angle, if not distorted.

matrix01.description: X component of the secondary distortion vector - the cosine of the normal vector's angle, if not distorted.

matrix11.description: Y component of the secondary distortion vector - the sine of the normal vector's angle, if not distorted.

innerRadius.description: Radius for circular fill distortion (type Centered only).

isInnerLine.description: Whether the edge is an inner line of the profile (GetProfiles' edges[].isInnerLine).

isCutEndLine.description: Whether the edge is a cut end line of the profile (GetProfiles' edges[].isCutEndLine).

polygonArcs.description: Optional arcs along this contour's edges. begIndex/endIndex are 0-based positions within this contour's own polygonCoordinates.

itemType.description: Separator, CenterDot, CenterLine, Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, or Arc.

centerOffset.description: Vertical distance from the origin. Used for Separator, CenterDot, and CenterLine item types.

length.description: Length of the item. Used for CenterLine, RightAngle, and Parallel item types.

begPos.description: Beginning position. Used for Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, and Arc item types.

endPos.description: End position. Used for Line item type only.

radius.description: Radius. Used for Circle and Arc item types.

beginAngle.description: Beginning angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

endAngle.description: End angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

index.description: Index of the pen [1..255].

width.description: Thickness of the pen defined in paper millimeters.

description.description: Textual description of the pen.

ProfileSkinData.description: One new skin (hatch). Its shape is one or more closed polygon contours: the first is the outer boundary, any further ones are holes cut out of it - the same polygon+holes convention as e.g. CreateSlabs' polygonCoordinates/polygonArcs/holes, just expressed as a list of contours instead of a separate holes array.

contours.description: Closed polygon contours forming this skin's cross-section, in the Profile's local coordinate system. Each contour is closed automatically - do not repeat its first vertex at the end.

edgeOverrides.description: Per-edge pen/visibility/line type, targeted by 0-based edge index. Edge indices follow the same order as this skin's contours/polygonCoordinates: the outer contour's edges first (one edge per vertex, wrapping around), then each hole's, in the order the contours were given. Verify exact indices for a created skin via a follow-up GetProfiles call's skins[].edges before relying on them.

PolyArc.description: Representation of an arc segment of a two dimensional polygon/polyline.

begIndex.description: Node index of one end point of the arc.

endIndex.description: Node index of the other end point of the arc.

arcAngle.description: Angle of the arc; it is positive, if the arc is on the right-hand side of the straight segment.

SnapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to while the designer clicks (Archicad's neig filter). Without it, the cursor snaps as usual.

base.description: What the cursor snaps to before include and exclude are applied: All = everything, None = nothing, Edges = only the lines and edges of the elements, Nodes = only their points (end points, vertices, hotspots). Default: None when include is given, otherwise All.

include.description: The cursor also snaps to these.

exclude.description: The cursor does not snap to these. Applied after include.

SnapType.description: A kind of point or line the cursor can snap to. An element type name means the element's points (end points, vertices, corners, hotspots); with On it means its lines and edges (for walls the reference line). Hotspot is a hotspot element, Text the corners of a text, Label the points of a label, Dimension a dimension point and DimensionOn the dimension line.

InputConstraint.description: Archicad's drawing constraint for the clicks of a Get...FromUser command: the cursor can only move along it, as when a coordinate is locked in the Tracker. It is dissolved when the command returns, also on Escape and on errors.

type.description: What is fixed: X = the X coordinate, Y = the Y coordinate, Z = the Z coordinate (3D window), Angle = the direction from the reference point (the cursor moves along a line), Distance = the distance from the reference point (the cursor moves along a circle).

value.description: The fixed value: a coordinate or distance in meters, or for Angle an angle in radians, counterclockwise from the X axis.

fromLastPoint.description: If true, the value is measured from the last clicked point (Archicad's local origin), otherwise from the project origin.

CoordinateSystem3D.description: A coordinate system in 3D: an origin and three axes. What is left out keeps its default; give all three axes together or none.

origin.description: The origin of the coordinate system.

xAxis.description: The X axis of the coordinate system.

yAxis.description: The Y axis of the coordinate system.

zAxis.description: The Z axis of the coordinate system.

ShellEdgeTrim.description: How a shell edge is cut.

trimType.description: Vertical, Perpendicular or Horizontal to the shell, or at 'angle' (CustomAngle).

angle.description: The trim angle in radians. Only CustomAngle uses it; pi/2 by default.

RoofEdgeTrim.description: How an edge of a single-plane roof's polygon is cut (the edge's cut in the roof's settings).

trimType.description: Vertical, Perpendicular to the roof plane, Horizontal, or at 'angle' (CustomAngle). AlignWithCut is only reported, for shell edges; it cannot be written to a roof.

angle.description: The angle of the edge cut in radians, as Archicad stores it. Only CustomAngle uses it.

ShellProfile.description: A profile polyline of a shell, in the XY plane of its coordinate system.

arcs.description: Arc segments of the polyline, with indices into coordinates; index len(coordinates) is the first point again, which closes the polyline.

closed.description: Whether the segment from the last point back to the first one is part of the profile. False by default.

ShellCutPolygon.description: A closed polygon cutting a shell: its clipping contour or a hole.

coordinates.description: The points of the polygon, in the XY plane of 'plane'.

arcs.description: Arc segments of the polygon, with indices into coordinates.

plane.description: The plane of the polygon, in the coordinates of the shell's base plane: a hole is extruded from it along its Z axis. The base plane itself by default.

depth.description: Required for holes, ignored for the clipping contour: how far the cutting body is extruded from the polygon's plane, along its Z axis (negative values cut downwards).

AxonometryProjectionType.description: The projection type of an axonometric 3D projection, the projMod of the Archicad API. Archicad works out the transformation matrix of every type but Custom from the type and the azimuth. XY is the top view and Bottom the view from below. YZ and XZ are both the side view (an elevation), looking from the azimuth. Frontal, Monometric, Isometric and Dimetric are the predefined axonometries, and FrontalBottom, MonometricBottom, IsometricBottom and DimetricBottom the same seen from below; an Isometric at azimuth 270 is the isometric from the south-east (X axis at -30 degrees, Y at 30, Z at 90). Custom keeps the transformation matrix as given. Parallel cannot be set: Archicad makes it Custom.

PerspectiveProjectionParameters.description: The parameters of a perspective projection of the 3D window.

targetPosition.description: The position of the target point the camera looks at.

distance.description: The distance between the camera and the target.

azimuth.description: The azimuth of the camera in degrees: the direction from the target to the camera, counterclockwise from the X axis. Archicad works it out from the camera and target positions, so a set value is replaced by that.

viewCone.description: The view cone angle of the camera in degrees.

rollAngle.description: The roll angle of the camera.

isTwoPointPersp.description: True for a two-point perspective (vertical edges stay vertical).

sun.description: The sun position of the perspective. Get3DProjectionSettings always returns it; Set3DProjectionSettings changes only the values given and keeps the current sun when it is missing.

ProjectionSunSettings.description: The sun position of a 3D projection, the Sun Position of the 3D Projection Settings dialog (API_SunAngleSettings). Each perspective and axonometry has its own, independent of the project's date and time (SetSunSettings). The 3D shading and shadows of the projection come from it.

sunPositionOption.description: Angles: the sun is at sunAzimuth and sunAltitude. DateAndTime: Archicad calculates the sun from the project location and the date and time given here.

sunAzimuth.description: The azimuth of the sun, used when sunPositionOption is Angles. In the same units Get3DProjectionSettings returns it.

sunAltitude.description: The altitude of the sun, used when sunPositionOption is Angles. In the same units Get3DProjectionSettings returns it.

year.description: Used when sunPositionOption is DateAndTime. 0 when no date is set.

month.description: Used when sunPositionOption is DateAndTime. 0 when no date is set.

day.description: Used when sunPositionOption is DateAndTime. 0 when no date is set.

summerTime.description: True when the time is daylight saving time.

name.description: The filename of the texture in the library (without extension).

xSize.description: X size of the picture in model space, by default 1.

ySize.description: Y size of the picture in model space, by default 1.

FillRectangle.description: True, if fit the rectangle with the picture in a central position, using the natural aspect ratio of the picture.

FitPicture.description: True, if fit the picture in the middle of the rectangle, using the natural aspect ratio of the picture.

mirrorX.description: True, if the texture is mirrored in X direction.

mirrorY.description: True, if the texture is mirrored in Y direction.

useAlphaChannel.description: True, if the alpha channel of the texture is used.

alphaChannelChangesTransparency.description: True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the transparency.

alphaChannelChangesSurfaceColor.description: True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the surface color.

alphaChannelChangesAmbientColor.description: True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the ambient color.

alphaChannelChangesSpecularColor.description: True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the specular color.

alphaChannelChangesDiffuseColor.description: True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the diffuse color.

OverriddenValue.description: A value the active graphic override combination may replace. 'overridden' tells whether it does; only then the value is given: 'attributeId' for line types, fills and surfaces, 'penIndex' for pens, 'color' for background pens and surfaces set to a color.

SuccessfulExecutionResult.description: The result of a successful execution.

FailedExecutionResult.description: The result of a failed execution.

DryRun.description: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

DryRunFlag.description: Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.

WouldDeleteExecutionResult.description: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would delete it.

DeletionExecutionResult.description: The result of a deletion for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldDelete instead of being deleted.

WouldChange.description: What a real run would change on a target. Each command says what its oldValue and newValue are; either is left out when it cannot be told cheaply.

oldValue.description: The target's value now, before the change.

newValue.description: The value a real run would write.

WouldChangeExecutionResult.description: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would change it as wouldChange says.

ChangeExecutionResult.description: The result of a change for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldChange instead of being changed.

ElementCategoryType.description: The type of an element category. The names of the categories and of their values are localized, so scripts should select a category by this type and a value by its categoryValueId, never by name. BRI is available only in the German localized version of Archicad.

ElementCategoryValueId.description: The identifier of a value of an element category.

ElementCategoryId.description: The identifier of an element category.

ElementFilter.description: A filter type for an element. Note: elements hidden by the design option combination of the current view (Archicad 29 or newer) fail IsVisibleByRenovation and pass IsOverriddenByRenovation even when the project has no renovation filter; use GetDesignOptionForElements and GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews to tell them apart.

ElementTypeFloorLayerFilter.description: A server-side element filter. An element matches when its type, its home story and its layer are each among the listed ones; an omitted or empty list does not filter.

NavigatorItemIdOrDatabaseIdAndWindowType.description: Identifies the window to change to. Either a navigatorItemId on its own (the navigator item's saved view settings are applied), or a windowType optionally narrowed to a specific databaseId, or a databaseId on its own (its window type is resolved automatically).

ElemProjectionMode.description: Floor plan projection mode of an element part (API_ElemProjectionModesID).

MeshRidges.description: How ridges between mesh facets are displayed in 3D: 'AllSharp' shows all ridges, 'AllSmooth' hides them, 'UserDefined' shows only ridges along user-defined level lines (the drawing-set look for contour-line topography).

CurtainWallPatternLogic.description: How the pattern unit fills the segment: 'FixedSizes' keeps the given sizes and repeats the unit, which may leave a partial unit at the end (Archicad: Fixed Size); 'BestDivision' stretches the flexible columns/rows so that whole units fill the segment with the least stretching (Archicad: Best Division).

CurtainWallPatternOrigin.description: Where the pattern unit is anchored on the segment: at its start, centered with a unit starting at the center, centered with a unit centered on the center, or at its end.

CurtainWallCrossingFrameType.description: The diagonal frame of a pattern cell: none, or from the bottom left to the top right corner, or from the top left to the bottom right corner.

BeamAnchorPoint.description: Anchor point of the beam cross section on a 3x3 grid.

ColumnCoreAnchor.description: Anchor point of the column core on a 3x3 grid.

SlabReferencePlaneLocation.description: Location of the slab reference plane.

WallReferenceLineLocation.description: The Core* values only have an effect on a Composite or Profile wall (structureType) - a Basic wall has no core skin, and Archicad falls back to the nearest non-core equivalent (e.g. CoreCenter becomes Center).

WallModificationGeometryType.description: The wall's plan outline shape, distinct from its cross section shape.

WallProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

WallModificationProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

ClassificationSystemConflictPolicy.description: What to do with a system whose name already exists: merge, replace it, or keep the existing one.

ClassificationItemConflictPolicy.description: What to do with an item whose id already exists in a merged system: replace it or keep the existing one.

PropertyImportConflictPolicy.description: What to do with a property whose name already exists in its group: append imports it under a new unused name, replace replaces the existing definition, skip keeps the existing one.

DesignOptionLinkType.description: The type of the associated design option.

MEPDomainOrUnknown.description: The reported MEP domain. Unknown indicates that the domain could not be determined.

DrawingNameType.description: How the drawing's title name is assembled (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

DrawingNumberingType.description: How the drawing's title ID is assigned (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

DrawingPenTableUsageMode.description: Which pen table the drawing uses (API_DrawingType::penTableUsageMode): its own, the one of the model, or the pen set given by penTableIndex.

DrawingColorMode.description: How the drawing's pens are output (API_DrawingType::colorMode).

DrawingAnchorPoint.description: The node of the drawing's bounding box the drawing is placed by (API_DrawingType::anchorPoint). Used only when useOwnOriginAsAnchor is false.

DrawingStatus.description: The Drawing Manager's Status column: UpToDate (OK) when the drawing matches its source, Modified when the source changed since the drawing was last updated, Unknown when the status cannot be determined (e.g. a missing external source).

DrawingLinkType.description: The kind of source a drawing is linked to (the Drawing Manager's Source column): a view of this project (InternalView), a view of another Archicad project file (ExternalView), a drawing file, a DWG/DXF file, a PDF, an image, a PlotMaker file, an Add-On generated drawing, or an unknown/other source.

MEPCrossSectionShape.description: Shape of an MEP routing segment's cross section or of an MEP port.

MEPConnectionStyle.description: How the pieces of an MEP routing segment, or an MEP port, are connected. For pipes, the settings dialog of Archicad 29 shows SimpleBody as Welded, and Welded is refused on a pipe route.

MEPFlowDirection.description: The flow direction of a piping or ventilation port.

MEPPreferredTransitionPlacement.description: Where an MEP routing node places its transitions.

MEPCutPlanePosition.description: Where the floor plan cut plane of an MEP routing element is. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPFloorPlanDisplayOption.description: How an MEP routing element is shown on the floor plan. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPShowProjection.description: How much of an MEP routing element's projection is shown on the floor plan. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPOnStoryVisibility.description: On which stories an MEP routing element is shown. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPPortDefaultDetails.description: The settings of one port of an MEP tool default. Each field is present only where the port's domain and the Archicad version have it: Archicad 27 gives only the index and the shape.

index.description: The index of the port in the default.

height.description: The height of a ventilation or cable carrier port.

diameter.description: The diameter of a piping port.

wallThickness.description: The wall thickness of a piping or ventilation port.

flowDirection.description: The flow direction of a piping or ventilation port.

flangeSize.description: The flange size of a piping or ventilation port, when it has flanges. Available from Archicad 30.

MEPElementDefaultDetails.description: The settings of a terminal, accessory, fitting, equipment or branch tool default.

libraryPartId.description: The library part the tool places.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness, when the default has insulation.

MEPDomainToolDefaults.description: The current settings of the MEP tools of one domain. A tool whose default Archicad does not give for the domain is left out; a setting is left out where the Archicad version does not have it.

routingSegment.description: The segment default of the routing tool.

anchor.description: The anchor point of the cross section, with the values of GetMEPRoutingElements.

routingNode.description: The node default of the routing tool.

elbow.description: The elbow default: Archicad 27 gives its radius factor (it calls elbows bends), Archicad 28 none, Archicad 29 and later both values.

rigidSegment.description: The rigid segment default of the routing tool.

width.description: Archicad 27 and 28.

height.description: Archicad 27 and 28.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness, when the default has insulation.

branch.description: The branch default of the routing tool.

flexibleSegment.description: The flexible segment tool default. Archicad 27 has it in the Ventilation domain only.

MEPPreferenceRowIndex.description: The position of the row in its preference table, as ModifyMEPPreferenceTables expects it. Rows that cannot be read are left out of GetMEPPreferenceTables, so this is not always the position in the rows list.

MEPPreferenceTableType.description: The kind of preference table container: the segment tables (circular and rectangular ducts share one container), or the elbow, branch or transition tables. CableCarrier has only segment tables, transition tables are available from Archicad 29.

MEPPreferenceRowChange.description: Changes one row of a preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values are changed. A value that does not belong to the kind of table is an error; the read-only values (reference ids, branchAxisAngle, isValid, and angle of an elbow table) are ignored.

delete.description: Deletes the row. The circular segment tables, and the elbow tables in Archicad 28, have a fixed row for each reference id; there the row is emptied instead. Cannot be combined with new values.

value.description: Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables. These tables keep their rows ordered by value, so a changed value can move the row; the indices of the other rows given in the same call are followed.

length.description: Branch tables and piping transition tables.

angle.description: Ventilation transition tables, in the unit GetMEPPreferenceTables returns it. Read-only (ignored) in elbow tables.

MEPPreferenceTableChange.description: Changes one preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values and rows are changed.

guid.description: The guid of the table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables.

name.description: The new name of the table.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Segment tables only. Available from Archicad 29.

minimumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the maximum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

maximumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the minimum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

rows.description: The rows to change or delete, each at most once. All indices refer to the table before this call.

newRows.description: Rows to add to a rectangular duct or cable carrier segment table, after the other changes. Adding rows to the other tables is not supported yet.

TrimType.description: Which side of the trimming element the elements keep.

NavigatorItemType.description: The type of the navigator item.

LabelClass.description: Whether this is a textual or a symbol label.

TextBoxAnchor.description: Anchor point of the text box.

LabelLeaderLineAnchorPoint.description: How the leader line connects to the label text.

SymbolLabelTextDirection.description: Direction of the symbol label's text.

LengthType.description: The type of the length measurement unit.

AreaType.description: The type of the area measurement unit.

VolumeType.description: The type of the volume measurement unit.

AngleType.description: The type of the angle measurement unit.

IssueElementType.description: The attachment type of an element component of an issue.

IssueCommentStatus.description: The status of an issue comment.

AssociativeWitnessPoint.description: A witness point of a dimension. Give elementId (with line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus and nodeId as needed) for a point associated with an element, or only coordinate for a static point that is not associated with any element, like a point added by hand on empty space. elementId together with coordinate gives an associative point at that location on the element.

coordinate.description: Without elementId: the position of a static (non-associative) witness point; the other fields are ignored for a static point. With elementId: the location of the associative point on the referenced element (written to its base location), e.g. where the dimension line crosses a long or oblique wall face; without it Archicad chooses the point, e.g. the middle of a wall edge. Whether Archicad keeps this location for every kind of base (edges with line true, or only hotspots) is not verified.

name.description: The name of the translator, as the IFC Translators dialog shows it.

preview.description: Whether this is the first item of Archicad's translator list, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator (the one the IFC properties of elements are previewed with). No API identifies the preview translator otherwise, and in some projects the IFC Translators dialog shows another translator as the preview one.

line.description: True when the witness point lies on an edge of the base element rather than at a node (API_Base line).

inIndex.description: Subindex of the base element's node (API_Neig inIndex).

special.description: Non-zero for special references such as a wall plane, a beam, window or door hole, or a mesh ridge (API_Base special).

nodeType.description: Reserved by Archicad for section dimensions (API_Base node_typ).

nodeStatus.description: Reserved by Archicad for section dimensions (API_Base node_status).

nodeId.description: Polygon vertex id of the base element, from its memo's vertexIDs, for elements with a polygon.

textHeight.description: Character height of the dimension text in mm, as the creation commands take it.

textPen.description: Pen index of the dimension text.

textFrame.description: Whether the dimension text has a frame.

FavoritesFromElementUpdate.description: The identifier of the element and the name of the existing Favorite to update from it.

solidLinksWithTheGivenTarget.description: Links where the given element is the target (being cut or modified).

linkTime.description: When the solid link was made, as a date and time string formatted like the times of revision issues. Omitted when Archicad does not report it.

solidLinksWithTheGivenOperator.description: Links where the given element is the operator (performing the cut).

linkTime.description: When the solid link was made, as a date and time string formatted like the times of revision issues. Omitted when Archicad does not report it.

projectInfoName.description: Display name of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: Initial value of the project info field.

projectInfoGroupId.description: The Project Info group to create the field in. Available from Archicad 30, where the field goes to the first group when omitted; on older versions giving it is an error.

targetId.description: The element to be cut or modified.

ElementLinkReference.description: A directional link from one element to another.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

ElementLinkData.description: A directional link from one element to another, with the flags stored on it.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: A 32-bit integer stored on the link, free for the script's own use (for example to tell apart the kinds of links it creates). Default is 0.

ElementLinksOrError.description: The links starting from an element, or an error.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the connected segment chain. Each consecutive pair of points becomes one segment, so a room with four walls needs five points to be closed, or four to be left open.

depth.description: How far each segment looks. Applied to every segment. Defaults to 1.0.

name.description: Name of the interior elevation. Each segment is named after it.

id.description: ID string of the interior elevation.

floorIndex.description: The story to place the interior elevation on. Defaults to the current story.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance's current z is kept.

rotationAngle.description: Rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians.

mirrored.description: Reflect the module's local X axis before the rotation.

layerIndex.description: Move the instance to this layer. A layerIndex that is not a layer of the project is refused.

hotlinkNodeId.description: The node to place, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. On Archicad 25 a node that has never been placed cannot be read, so a node created through the API can only be placed from Archicad 26 on.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance is placed at 0.

rotationAngle.description: Optional rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians. Defaults to 0.

mirrored.description: Optional. Reflects the module's local X axis before the rotation. Defaults to false.

floorIndex.description: Optional story the instance is placed on. Defaults to the current story.

floorDifference.description: Optional story offset applied to the module's stories. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer of the instance. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default layer, or to the built-in Archicad layer when that layer has been deleted. A layerIndex that is not a layer of the project is refused.

skipNested.description: Optional. Do not place hotlinks nested inside the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

suspendFixAngle.description: Optional. Rotate fixed-angle elements with the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

ignoreTopFloorLinks.description: Optional. Top-linked elements keep their height rather than their top story link. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

relinkWallOpenings.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

adjustLevelDiffs.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

name.description: Library name.

path.description: A filesystem path to library location.

type.description: Library type.

twServerUrl.description: URL address of the TeamWork server hosting the library.

urlWebLibrary.description: URL of the downloaded Internet library.

LibraryPackage.description: Package information of a library that is a library package. Only given for packages, from Archicad 28. A value Archicad cannot read is left out.

mainVersion.description: The main version of the package.

subVersion.description: The sub version of the package.

minArchicadVersion.description: The minimum Archicad version the package needs.

minArchicadBuildNumber.description: The minimum Archicad build number the package needs.

dependencies.description: The packages this package depends on.

name.description: The name of the package.

version.description: The version of the package that is needed.

PropertyAvailabilityUpdate.description: Classification items the property is available for: set replaces the list, add and remove edit it.

id.description: The new code of the item, e.g. 21.10.

name.description: New name of the property.

description.description: New description of the property.

isEditable.description: Whether users may edit the value of the property on elements (Property Manager: Editable).

groupId.description: Move the property into this custom property group.

defaultValue.description: New default value: a basic value or expressions. Switching between the two is allowed.

expressions.description: The new expression strings for the property. Only for expression-based properties.

possibleEnumValues.description: Values already on the property keep their identifier, so element values assigned to them survive; values not listed here are kept as well.

renameEnumValues.description: Change the text of existing enum options. The option keeps its identifier, so element values follow the new text.

removeEnumValues.description: Enum options to remove. Elements holding a removed option lose that value.

enumOrder.description: Every option's display text, once, in the new order (applied after rename, remove and add).

guid.description: The identifier of the enumeration value, as reported by GetAllProperties. An element's stored value refers to the value by this.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

EnumValueToAdd.description: Text values for an enumeration option to add.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

PropertyGroupId.description: The identifier of a property group.

PropertyGroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property group identifier.

PropertyIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property identifier.

isExpressionBased.description: True if the property value is computed from an expression.

expressions.description: The expression strings of an expression-based property. Only present when isExpressionBased is true.

defaultValueDisplay.description: The basic default value as text. Only for custom, non expression-based properties whose default is set.

availability.description: Classification items a custom property is available for.

defaultEnumValueIds.description: The option guids an enumeration property's default holds. Only for custom enumeration properties whose default is set.

PropertyValue.description: The string value of a property, formatted according to the command's options.

PropertyValueArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueErrorItem.description: An error in place of a property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueOrErrorItem.description: A property value or an error

PropertyValuesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property values.

PropertyValuesOrError.description: A list of property values or an error.

PropertyValuesOrErrorArray.description: A list of property value lists.

ElementPropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner element.

valueStatus.description: Value (the default) sets propertyValue. Default removes the element's own value, so the property shows its default value (or its expression) again. UserUndefined sets the value to undefined. propertyValue is not needed and is ignored for Default and UserUndefined.

ElementPropertyValues.description: A list of element property values.

AttributePropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner attribute.

AttributePropertyValues.description: A list of attribute property values.

DisplayValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the displayed value.

NonLocalizedValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the nonlocalized value.

EnumValueId.description: The identifier of a property enumeration value.

EnumValueIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the identifier of a property enumeration value.

NormalOrUserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A normal or a userUndefined property value.

PropertyValueDetails.description: A normal, userUndefined, notAvailable or notEvaluated property value.

UserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A userUndefined value means that there is no actual number/string/etc. value, but the user deliberately set an Undefined value: this is a valid value, too.

NotAvailablePropertyValue.description: A notAvailable value means that the property is not available for the property owner (and therefore it has no property value for it).

NormalNumberPropertyValue.description: A number property value containing a valid numeric value.

NormalIntegerPropertyValue.description: An integer property value containing a valid integer number.

NormalStringPropertyValue.description: A string property value containing a valid string.

NormalBooleanPropertyValue.description: A boolean property value containing a valid boolean value.

NormalLengthPropertyValue.description: A length property value containing a real length value. The value is measured in SI (meters).

NormalAreaPropertyValue.description: An area property value containing a real area. The value is measured in SI (square meters).

NormalVolumePropertyValue.description: A volume property value containing a real volume. The value is measured in SI (cubic meters).

NormalAnglePropertyValue.description: An angle property value containing a real angle. The value is measured in SI (radians).

NormalNumberListPropertyValue.description: A number list property value containing numbers in an array.

NormalIntegerListPropertyValue.description: An integer list property value containing integers in an array.

NormalStringListPropertyValue.description: A string list property value containing strings in an array.

NormalBooleanListPropertyValue.description: A boolean list property value containing boolean values in an array.

NormalLengthListPropertyValue.description: A length list property value containing length values in an array. The values are measured in SI (meters).

NormalAreaListPropertyValue.description: An area list property value containing areas in an array. The values are measured in SI (square meters).

NormalVolumeListPropertyValue.description: A volume list property value containing volumes in an array. The values are measured in SI (cubic meters).

NormalAngleListPropertyValue.description: An angle list property value containing angles in an array. The values are measured in SI (radians).

NormalSingleEnumPropertyValue.description: A single enumeration property value containing the ID of the selected enum value.

NormalMultiEnumPropertyValue.description: A multiple choice enumeration property value containing the IDs of the selected enum values in an array.

BasicDefaultValue.description: Default value of the property in case of a basic property value (ie. not an expression).

ExpressionDefaultValue.description: Default value of the property in case of an expression based property value.

ClassificationSystemId.description: The identifier of a classification system.

ClassificationSystemIds.description: A list of classification system identifiers.

Date.description: A date in its string representation as defined in ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD.

ClassificationSystemDetails.description: The details of a classification system.

name.description: The display name of the classification system.

description.description: The description of the classification system.

source.description: The source of the classification system (e.g. URL to a classification system standard).

version.description: The version of the classification system.

date.description: The release date of the classification system's current version.

ClassificationItemDetails.description: The details of a classification item.

id.description: The unique identifier of the classification item as specified by the user.

name.description: The display name of the classification item.

description.description: The description of the classification item.

classificationItems.description: A list of classification items in the classification system.

parentClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of the parent classification item. If not specified, the new classification item will be created as a child of the root.

nextClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of the next sibling classification item. If not specified, the new classification item will be created as the last child of its parent.

ClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of a classification item.

ClassificationItemIds.description: A list of classification item identifiers.

classificationItemId.description: The element's classification in the given system. If no value is specified here, the element is Unclassified in this system.

ClassificationIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the classification identifier.

ClassificationIdOrError.description: A classification identifier or an error.

ClassificationSystemIdOrError.description: A classification system identifier or an error.

ClassificationSystemIdsOrErrors.description: A list of classification system identifiers or errors.

ClassificationItemIdOrError.description: A classification item identifier or an error.

ClassificationItemIdsOrErrors.description: A list of classification item identifiers or errors.

DesignOptionIdOrError.description: A design option identifier or an error.

DesignOptionCombinationIdOrError.description: A design option combination identifier or an error.

ClassificationIdsOrErrors.description: A list of element classification identifiers or errors.

classificationIds.description: The classification of the attribute in every classification system it is classified in.

classificationId.description: The classification to set. The item replaces the attribute's current item in the same classification system. If the classificationItemId field is omitted, the attribute becomes unclassified in the given system.

classificationIds.description: One item for each classification system in which the tool default is classified. Systems in which it is unclassified are left out.

name.description: The display name of the classification system.

description.description: The description of the classification system.

source.description: The source of the classification system (e.g. URL to a classification system standard).

version.description: The version of the classification system.

date.description: The release date of the classification system's current version.

classificationSystemId.description: The classification system the item belongs to.

parentClassificationItemId.description: The parent item. Missing for a top level item of its system.

visibilities.description: One entry per classification item, in the order of the input. A non-existing classification item is represented by an error object.

isVisible.description: Whether the classification item is visible (offered) for the target, as Archicad reports it. It can be true even if a parent item is not visible. It does not tell whether the target is classified with the item.

AttributePropertyValueStatus.description: A property value with its status, returned when includeStatus is true.

propertyValue.description: Missing when the value is not available or not evaluated.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property definition is available for the attribute.

isEditable.description: Whether the value of the property is editable for the attribute.

isVisible.description: Whether the property definition is visible for the attribute.

ToolDefaultPropertyFilter.description: Which property definitions to return: the user defined (custom) ones, the fundamental built-in ones, the user level built-in ones, or all of them. The default is All. From Archicad 28 the API no longer separates the two kinds of built-in properties, so there FundamentalBuiltIn and UserLevelBuiltIn both return every built-in property.

propertyValue.description: The value in the tool default, in the format of GetPropertyValuesOfElements. Only returned when includeValues is true.

error.description: Why the value could not be read. Only returned when includeValues is true.

available.description: Whether the property is available for the tool default of the element type.

visible.description: Whether the property is visible for the tool default of the element type.

propertyObjects.description: The property objects (library parts of the old listing system) of the element, linked to it by criteria or individually. Empty when the element has none.

libraryPartIndex.description: The index of the property object's library part, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

name.description: The name of the library part. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

guid.description: The guid of the library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

isIndividuallyAssigned.description: True when the property object is assigned to the element individually, false when it is linked by criteria.

descriptors.description: The descriptors in the property objects of the element. Empty when the element has none.

libraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part that declares the descriptor, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

name.description: The name of the library part. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

guid.description: The guid of the library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

setIndex.description: The index of the listing database set of the descriptor. Meaningful only when status is Normal.

index.description: The index of the descriptor in the listing database set when status is Normal, in the library part when status is Local.

ElementDescriptorStatus.description: Normal: the descriptor exists in the listing database. Deleted: it is referenced, but deleted from the database. Local: it is defined in the library part. Unknown for a value this version of Tapir does not name.

linkByCriteria.description: True when the property objects matching their criteria are linked to the element.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the individually assigned property object, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 when no property object is assigned individually.

individualLibraryPartName.description: The name of the individually assigned library part. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

individualLibraryPartGuid.description: The guid of the individually assigned library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

criteriaPropertyObjects.description: The linked property objects whose criteria match the element.

libraryPartIndex.description: The index of the property object's library part, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

name.description: The name of the library part. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

guid.description: The guid of the library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

DesignOptionIdsOrErrors.description: A list of design option identifiers or errors.

DesignOptionCombinationIdsOrErrors.description: A list of design option combination identifiers or errors.

ProjectInfoGroupIdOrError.description: A Project Info group identifier or an error.

ProjectInfoGroupIdsOrErrors.description: A list of Project Info group identifiers or errors.

CreatedProjectInfoFieldOrError.description: A created project info field or an error.

CreatedProjectInfoFieldsOrErrors.description: A list of created project info fields or errors, one per requested field.

ElementClassificationItemArray.description: A wrapper containing a list of element classification identifiers or errors.

classificationIds.description: A list of element classification identifiers or errors, one per classification system.

ElementClassificationsOrErrors.description: A list of element classification identifiers or errors.

ElementIFCProperty.description: The details of an IFC property value of an element.

value.description: The value of the property as a string. List and enumerated values are separated by semicolons.

valueType.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel or IfcLengthMeasure. For a table value it is the type of its defined values. Left out when the property has no value to take the type from.

enumerationReference.description: For an enumerated value, the values of the enumeration it refers to (IfcPropertyEnumeration), each as a string. Available from Archicad 28; left out when the property has none.

IFCObject.description: An object of the IFC model of the project, as the IFC API of Archicad 28 and later identifies it.

hashValue.description: The hash value of the IFC object identifier (ObjectID::GenerateHashValue), for matching the objects of one response to each other. It is not stable between sessions; use elementId or globalId to identify an object.

elementId.description: The element the IFC object belongs to. Left out when Archicad reports no element for it.

ifcType.description: The IFC entity type of the object, for example IfcWall. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

globalId.description: The IFC GlobalId of the object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

ElementIFCProperties.description: The IFC properties of an element.

ElementIFCAttribute.description: An IFC attribute of an element, for example Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType or LongName.

name.description: The name of the IFC attribute.

valueType.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel, IfcText or IfcIdentifier.

value.description: The value of the IFC attribute. Missing when the attribute has no value.

ElementIFCAttributes.description: The IFC attributes of an element.

ElementIFCAttributesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC attributes of elements or errors.

ElementIFCType.description: The IFC type of an element.

ElementIFCIds.description: The IFC identifiers of an element.

ifcId.description: The IFC identifier of the element. From Archicad 28 it is the IFC GlobalId (22 characters); before Archicad 28 it is the same identifier in the 36 character GUID form, and ifcGlobalId gives its GlobalId.

externalIFCId.description: The external IFC identifier of the element, in the same form as ifcId.

ifcGlobalId.description: The IFC GlobalId (22 characters) of ifcId. Only returned before Archicad 28, where ifcId is in the GUID form; from Archicad 28 ifcId already is the GlobalId.

externalIFCGlobalId.description: The IFC GlobalId (22 characters) of externalIFCId, empty when the element has no external IFC identifier. Only returned before Archicad 28.

ElementIFCPropertiesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC properties of elements or errors.

ElementIFCTypesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC types of elements or errors.

ElementIFCIdsOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC identifiers of elements or errors.

ElementIFCClassificationReference.description: An IFC classification reference (IfcClassificationReference) of an element. The text fields are missing when the reference has no value for them.

identification.description: The identification of the classification reference, for example a classification code.

name.description: The name of the classification reference.

location.description: The location of the classification reference, for example a URL.

description.description: The description of the classification reference. Given from Archicad 29.

sort.description: The sort key of the classification reference (its Sort attribute). Given from Archicad 29, missing when it has no value.

relAssociatesClassificationName.description: The name of the IfcRelAssociatesClassification relationship that links the reference to the element. Given from Archicad 28, missing when it is empty.

referencedSource.description: The classification (IfcClassification) the reference belongs to.

name.description: The name of the classification.

source.description: The source of the classification. Missing when it has no value.

edition.description: The edition of the classification. Missing when it has no value.

editionDate.description: The edition date of the classification. Missing when it has no value.

description.description: The description of the classification. Missing when it has no value.

location.description: The location of the classification, for example a URL. Missing when it has no value.

source.description: Where the reference comes from: preview (mapped by the preview IFC export translator) or local (stored on the element). Missing in Archicad 25, 26 and 27, where the storedOnly input chooses between the stored references and all of them.

ElementIFCClassificationReferences.description: The IFC classification references of an element.

ElementIFCClassificationReferencesOrErro.description: Element IFC classification references or error.
A list of the IFC classification references of elements or errors.

ElementsByIFCIds.description: A list of elements identified by their IFC identifiers or errors.

elements.description: A list of element identifiers having the given IFC identifier. If the given IFC identifier is an external identifier, the list can contain multiple elements as the IFC can be placed multiple times.

ElementClassifications.description: A list of element classification identifiers.

BoundingBox3D.description: A 3D bounding box of an element.

xMin.description: The minimum X value of the bounding box.

yMin.description: The minimum Y value of the bounding box.

zMin.description: The minimum Z value of the bounding box.

xMax.description: The maximum X value of the bounding box.

yMax.description: The maximum Y value of the bounding box.

zMax.description: The maximum Z value of the bounding box.

BoundingBox3DArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a 3D bounding box.

BoundingBox3DOrError.description: A 3D bounding box or an error.

BoundingBox2DArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a 2D bounding box.

BoundingBox2DOrError.description: A 2D bounding box or an error.

Body3D.description: One solid body of an element's 3D model: a flat vertex list in world coordinates and the planar faces referencing it. The faces are not triangulated: a face is a closed loop of vertex indices (counterclockwise seen from outside the body) plus the loops of its holes.

vertices.description: The vertices of the body in world coordinates (meters, absolute Z).

vertexIds.description: The outer contour of the face: 0-based indices into vertices.

holes.description: The holes in the face, each a closed loop of 0-based indices into vertices.

surfaceId.description: The surface attribute of the face. Left out when the face's material is not a project attribute (for example one defined by a GDL script).

StoredGDLParameter.description: A GDL parameter as it is stored with a marker or a Favorite, read without a parameter interface (so without isLocked and possibleValues).

name.description: The name of the parameter.

displayName.description: The display name of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

value.description: The value of the parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

type.description: The type of the MEP element.

domain.description: The MEP domain of the element. Empty for domain-independent elements (e.g. Equipment).

localizedTypeName.description: The type name of the element in the language of Archicad. Only returned by Archicad 28.

physicalSystemIds.description: The physical systems of the distribution system. From Archicad 29; missing when Archicad could not tell.

tree.description: The elements of the system from its root element on, in the order Archicad traverses them. Only returned when includeTree is true, and missing when Archicad could not traverse the system.

MEPDistributionSystemTreeNode.description: An element of a distribution system tree.

depth.description: The number of steps from the root element; 0 for the root element.

previousElementId.description: The element before this one on the way from the root element. Missing for the root element.

connectedPortIdOfPreviousElement.description: The port of the previous element this element is connected to (see GetMEPPorts). Missing when Archicad gives none.

connectedPortIdOfThisElement.description: The port of this element that is connected to the previous element (see GetMEPPorts). Missing when Archicad gives none.

nextElements.description: The elements after this one, away from the root element.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Whether the table uses individual segmentation lengths. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPValuePreferenceTable.description: A rectangular duct or cable carrier segment preference table: a list of sizes.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Whether the table uses individual segmentation lengths. Available from Archicad 29.

value.description: The size of the row.

OpeningRelationsOfElement.description: Relations of a curtain wall panel, skylight, window or door: the zones on the two sides of the opening.

RoofOrShellRelationsOfElement.description: Relations of a roof or shell: the connected zones.

NavigatorItemIds.description: A list of navigator item identifiers.

NavigatorItemId.description: The identifier of a navigator item.

NavigatorItem.description: A navigator item and the subtree below it.

name.description: The name of the navigator item.

prefix.description: The floor number for story items, an empty string for every other item type.

uiId.description: The identifier shown next to the name on the navigator.

customUiId.description: True when the identifier was typed by hand instead of being inherited from the Project Map source - the View Settings ID "Custom" radio button.

customName.description: True when the name was typed by hand instead of being inherited from the Project Map source - the View Settings name "Custom" radio button.

isIndependent.description: True when the item is independent, that is when its link to the Project Map is broken.

sourceNavigatorItemId.description: The identifier of the navigator item this one was created from: the Project Map item behind a view, or the source view behind a placed Drawing's Layout Book entry. Missing when the item has no such source; Project Map items never do.

childCount.description: The number of direct children Archicad reports for the item. Only present when GetNavigatorItemTree is called with includeChildCount true.

children.description: The children of the navigator item. Missing when the item has no children.

ViewSettings.description: The settings of a navigator view

modelViewOptions.description: The name of the model view options. If empty, the view has custom model view options.

layerCombination.description: The name of the layer combination. If empty, the view has custom layer combination.

dimensionStyle.description: The name of the dimension style. If empty, the view has custom dimension style.

penSetName.description: The name of the pen set. If empty, the view has custom pen set.

graphicOverrideCombination.description: The name of the graphic override combination. If empty, the view has custom graphic override combination.

drawingScale.description: The drawing scale stored on the view, if enabled (see saveFlags.drawingScale). Giving it to SetViewSettings also turns saveFlags.drawingScale on, unless that flag is given explicitly.

saveZoom.description: Whether the zoom box is stored in the view. The same flag as saveFlags.zoom, kept for compatibility; in SetViewSettings saveFlags.zoom wins when both are given.

ignoreSavedZoom.description: Whether changing to the view should ignore its stored zoom.

zoom.description: Stored zoom box. Used only when saveZoom is true. Giving it to SetViewSettings also turns saveFlags.zoom on, unless that flag is given explicitly.

saveFlags.description: Which settings the view stores: the "stored in this view" checkboxes of the View Settings dialog. A stored setting whose name field is empty is a custom (unnamed) one; a setting that is not stored is not part of the view at all, which the name fields alone cannot tell apart. Always complete in a GetViewSettings response. In SetViewSettings every flag is optional, a flag that is not given keeps its current value, and a flag given here overrides the one implied by drawingScale, zoom, structureDisplay or saveZoom.

zoom.description: Whether the zoom box is stored in the view.

displayOptions.description: Whether the model view options are stored in the view (named by modelViewOptions, custom if that is empty).

layers.description: Whether the layer settings are stored in the view (named by layerCombination, custom if that is empty).

drawingScale.description: Whether the drawing scale is stored in the view.

dimensions.description: Whether the dimension settings are stored in the view (named by dimensionStyle, custom if that is empty).

penSet.description: Whether the pen set is stored in the view (named by penSetName, custom if that is empty).

structureDisplay.description: Whether the structure display mode is stored in the view.

rotation.description: View rotation angle in radians, derived from transformationMatrix. Read via GetViewSettings; use SetViewRotation to change it.

transformationMatrix.description: The full 2D transformation of the view that rotation is derived from: the 3x4 matrix row by row (12 numbers), in the layout Get3DProjectionSettings uses. Its translation is at indices 3 and 7. Read via GetViewSettings; SetViewSettings ignores it, use rotation or SetViewRotation to change the rotation and translation to change the translation.

translation.description: SetViewSettings only: the translation part of the view transformation (indices 3 and 7 of transformationMatrix), so that view coordinates = rotation applied to model coordinates + translation. rotation leaves the translation as it is; without this field the translation is not changed. {x: 0, y: 0} clears it. Never returned by GetViewSettings (read it from transformationMatrix).

structureDisplay.description: Structure display mode. One of EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes, StructureOnly.

renovationFilterGuid.description: Identifier of the renovation filter applied to the view.

renovationFilterName.description: Name of the renovation filter applied to the view. Read-only (GetViewSettings): present together with renovationFilterGuid when the name could be resolved; set the filter via renovationFilterGuid.

d3styleName.description: Name of the 3D style. Empty if not set.

renderingSceneName.description: Name of the rendering scene. Empty if not set.

usePhotoRendering.description: Whether photo rendering is used for this view.

Hole2D.description: A 2D hole in an element defined by closed polylines. The outline is given in 'polygonOutline'; 'polygonCoordinates' is accepted as a legacy alias.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the hole.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

Holes2D.description: A list of 2D holes in an element defined by closed polylines

Hole3D.description: A 3D hole in an element defined by closed polylines

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the polygon of the hole.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

Holes3D.description: A list of 3D holes in an element defined by closed polylines

height.description: height relative to bottom

bottomOffset.description: base level of the wall relative to the floor level

offset.description: wall's base line's offset from ref. line

arcAngle.description: The arc angle of the curved wall in radians.

begThickness.description: Thickness at the beginning of wall, it will return 0 for poly wall type

endThickness.description: Thickness at the end of wall, it will return 0 for poly wall type

polygonOutline.description: Polygon outline in case of polygonal wall

polygonArcs.description: Polygon arcs in case of polygonal wall

profileType.description: Only Normal/Slanted/Trapez are settable via ModifyWalls - Poly needs a profile attribute wired through a separate mechanism. slantAlpha/slantBeta only have an effect once this is Slanted or Trapez.

slantAlpha.description: Only has an effect once profileType is set to Slanted or Trapez.

slantBeta.description: Only has an effect once profileType is set to Slanted or Trapez.

topOffset.description: Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the wall's top to another story instead of an explicit height - do not set together with 'height' via ModifyWalls in the same call.

visibility.description: On Archicad 29 a wall knows only 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories' (Wall Settings offers no Custom option), so a wall can read back a combination the dialog cannot show - a wall fresh from the Wall tool defaults may report showOnHome false with showRelAbove 1, which Wall Settings shows as an empty Show on Stories field (#852). See ModifyWalls for which combinations can be written.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true (the default on a new wall), Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the wall's vertical extent and ignores any value set for it.

contourPen.description: Pen of the wall's own contour/reference outline (API_WallType::contPen) - distinct from cutFillPen, which is the cut fill pattern's pen inherited from the building material/composite/profile. Unlike cutFillPen this is not inheritable/overridable, it is the wall's own pen index directly, the same field used regardless of structureType (Basic, Composite or Profile).

contourPen3D.description: Pen of the wall's contour in 3D views (API_WallType::contPen3D).

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the wall's own contour (API_WallType::contLtype) - pairs with contourPen, which only sets the pen, not the line type.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "OutLines Only" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup (API_WallType::belowViewLineType). Corresponds to the "Uncut Lines" value in the Wall Settings dialog.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup. Corresponds to the "Overhead Line Pens" value in the Wall Settings dialog.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

viewDepthLimitation.description: Only has an effect on a multi-story wall (relativeTopStory/topOffset making it span more than one story).

connectionPriority.description: Priority of the wall in a junction with other elements (API_WallType::wallConnPriority - higher wins the cut/cover at the junction). Archicad ignores writes to this field; read-only in practice.

useCompositePriority.description: When true, the Composite's own priority is used at junctions instead of connectionPriority.

junctionSequence.description: Tie-breaker (0-999) used when two walls meet with the same connectionPriority, or when 3+ walls meet in a junction (API_WallType::sequence). Archicad ignores writes to this field; read-only in practice.

linkToSettings.description: newCreationMode is expected to read back as false after creation; Archicad resolves the relative story selection to an absolute floor index.

inheritEndSurface.description: The end surface of the wall is inherited from the adjoining wall.

alignTexture.description: Align texture mapping to the wall's edges.

offsetFromOutside.description: Distance between the reference line and the outside face of the wall. Output only - not settable via ModifyWalls.

polyCanChange.description: The polygonal wall's corners can be changed in case of L and T connections. Only meaningful for a Polygonal wall (geometryType).

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

logHeight.description: Height of the log for log walls. 0 means a normal (non-log) wall.

hasWindow.description: Whether the wall has at least one Window. Output only.

hasDoor.description: Whether the wall has at least one Door. Output only.

level.description: base height of the beam relative to the floor level

offset.description: beam ref.line offset from the center

slantAngle.description: The slant angle of the beam in radians.

arcAngle.description: The arc angle of the (horizontally) curved beam in radians.

verticalCurveHeight.description: The height of the vertical curve of the beam.

width.description: Cross section width of the beam (all segments).

height.description: Cross section height of the beam (all segments).

circleBased.description: True for a round beam cross section, false for rectangular.

isWidthAndHeightLinked.description: When true, Archicad keeps width and height equal - set to false via ModifyBeams/CreateBeams to give them independent values.

buildingMaterialId.description: Present when the cross section uses a building material rather than a custom profile.

profileId.description: Present when the cross section uses a custom extruded profile rather than a building material.

segments.description: The surfaces of each segment of the beam.

level.description: Height of the pivot line (single-plane) or the pivot polygon (multi-plane) above the floor level.

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, Archicad recomputes 'visibility' and 'fillVisibility' automatically from the roof's vertical extent.

visibility.description: The stories the roof's contour is shown on (API_ShellBaseType::visibilityCont).

fillVisibility.description: The stories the roof's cover fill is shown on (API_ShellBaseType::visibilityFill).

cutBodyType.description: How the roof's body is extended for connections with other elements (API_ShellBaseType::cutBodyType, on the Model panel of Roof Settings).

sectionContourPen.description: Pen of the roof's contour where it is cut (API_ShellBaseType::sectContPen).

sectionContourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the roof's contour where it is cut (API_ShellBaseType::sectContLtype) - pairs with sectionContourPen.

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the roof's contour (API_ShellBaseType::ltypeInd) - pairs with contourPen.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

angle.description: Single-plane: the slope in radians.

eavesOverhang.description: Multi-plane: the eaves overhang beyond the pivot polygon.

levels.description: Multi-plane: the roof levels, each with its height above the previous and its slope in radians.
