profileParameter.description: Matches elements by a custom Complex Profile modifier parameter, identified by its plain name as defined on that Complex Profile attribute (e.g. 'Debord tole') rather than a fixed field - use this for any profile modifier not covered by the profileStretchHeight/profileNominalWidth/... fields above. Provide 'name' and exactly one comparison operator.

name.description: The profile modifier parameter's name, exactly as defined on the Complex Profile attribute.

customPropertyBool.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) boolean property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under (both exactly as shown in the Property Manager). Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one of the operators below. The 6 'has.../is...' operators are available on every custom property type, not just boolean ones.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined (e.g. 'Generalites').

equals.description: Matches if the property's value equals this.

hasDefaultValue.description: If true, matches elements where this property currently has its default value.

hasCustomValue.description: If true, matches elements where this property has a custom (overridden, non-default) value.

isAvailable.description: If true, matches elements where this property is available.

isNotAvailable.description: If true, matches elements where this property is not available.

isUndefined.description: If true, matches elements where this property is undefined.

isNotUndefined.description: If true, matches elements where this property is not undefined.

customPropertyString.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) text or option-set property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

equals.description: Matches if the property's value equals this string exactly.

notEquals.description: Matches if the property's value does not equal this string.

customPropertyNumber.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) numeric property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

customPropertyInteger.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) integer property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

GraphicOverrideCombinationIdOrError.description: A graphic override combination identifier or an error.

GraphicOverrideFillTypes.description: The fill types an override applies to.

GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes.description: The surface types an override applies to.

GraphicOverrideStyle.description: What a graphic override rule overrides and how. A field that is left out is not overridden.

lineType.description: The line type that replaces the line type of lines.

lineMarkerTextPen.description: The pen index that replaces the pen of lines, markers and texts.

fillType.description: The fill type that replaces the fill type of fills.

fillTypeAppliesTo.description: The fills the fill type override applies to. Left out: all fills.

fillForegroundPen.description: The pen index that replaces the foreground pen of fills.

fillForegroundPenAppliesTo.description: The fills the foreground pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.

fillBackgroundPen.description: The pen index that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundColor.

fillBackgroundColor.description: The color that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundPen.

fillBackgroundPenAppliesTo.description: The fills the background pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.

surface.description: The surface that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surfaceColor.

surfaceColor.description: The color that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surface.

surfaceAppliesTo.description: The surfaces the surface override applies to. Left out: all surfaces.

overridePenColorAndThickness.description: Override the pen color and thickness.

hiddenContours.description: The contours to hide when overrideContours is true.

GraphicOverrideRule.description: A graphic override rule with its rule group, criterion and style.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group the rule belongs to.

criterionXML.description: The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules to make similar rules.

criterion.description: The criterion as structured conditions, returned with includeCriterion. It can be passed to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules as it is. The top 'and' holds the rows of the criteria editor's table; a row with several values is an 'or' or 'and' of them, and values joined with 'and' within an 'or' row are one more 'and'. A condition that is not decoded yet is a {"criterionXML": ...} leaf, written back unchanged. Left out when criterionXML is not in the format Archicad keeps rules in.

GraphicOverrideRuleOrError.description: A graphic override rule or an error.

AnalyticalModelVariation.description: The variation a Structural Analytical Model is generated for. Its fields depend on the Archicad version: amVariationGuid from Archicad 27, renovationFilterGuid and layerConnectionClassIds before.

amVariationGuid.description: The identifier of the analytical model variation. Archicad 27 and newer.

renovationFilterGuid.description: The identifier of the renovation filter of the variation. Archicad 25 and 26.

layerConnectionClassIds.description: The connection classes of the layers. Archicad 25: a list of integers. Archicad 26: one object per layer, with the layer's attribute index and its connection class.

layerIndex.description: The attribute index of the layer.

connectionClassId.description: The connection class of the layer.

AnalyticalMemberType.description: The analytical member type of an element.

AnalyticalVisibilitySettings.description: The visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model. Archicad 26 and newer.

visibilityMode.description: Whether only the analytical model is shown or the analytical model within the entire model.

loadVisibilityMode.description: Which loads are shown: filtered by the active settings, none or all.

AnalyticalLoadGroupType.description: The type of a structural analysis load group.

AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation.description: How the load cases of a structural analysis load group are combined.

AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType.description: The action type of a structural analysis load case.

AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType.description: The load type of a structural analysis load case.

AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration.description: The duration of a structural analysis load case.

AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory.description: The category of a structural analysis load combination.

AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandar.description: The national standard of a structural analysis load combination.

AnalyticalLoadCombinationType.description: The type of a structural analysis load combination. Archicad 27 and newer.

AnalyticalLoadFactor.description: A load case of a structural analysis load combination with its factors.

loadCaseId.description: The identifier of the load case.

factor.description: The factor of the load case. Left out when it is not set.

multiplier.description: The multiplier of the load case.

loadType.description: The load type of the group as free text.

loadGroupId.description: The identifier of the load group the load case belongs to.

duration.description: Left out when it is not set.

nationalStandard.description: Left out when it is not set.

type.description: Left out when it is not set. Archicad 27 and newer.

loadFactors.description: The load cases of the combination with their factors.

AnalyticalNode.description: A node of the Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalCurve.description: A curve of the Structural Analytical Model.

type.description: The type of the curve. Bezier exists from Archicad 26.

midCoords.description: The points between the start and the end of the curve.

AnalyticalCrossSection.description: The cross section of a curve member. The profile image of Archicad 26 and newer is not returned.

profileAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the profile.

materialAttrIndices.description: The attribute indices of the materials of the cross section.

alignment.description: The alignment of the cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.

AnalyticalCurveMember.description: A curve member (beam, column) of the Structural Analytical Model.

layerAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the layer.

varyingSegmentList.description: The segments of a member with varying cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.

AnalyticalSurfaceMember.description: A surface member (wall, slab, roof) or a segment of one of the Structural Analytical Model.

contour.description: The curves of the outer contour.

lcsXVector.description: The X axis of the local coordinate system. Archicad 26 and newer.

materialAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the material.

layerAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the layer.

AnalyticalMemberConnections.description: The identifiers of the connections of the analytical member.

AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId.description: Identifies a part of an analytical member by its contour, edge or vertex and edge fragment.

AnalyticalExportIdMapping.description: Maps the edges and vertices of a surface member to the parts of the exported members. Archicad 26 and newer.

AnalyticalMemberPartRef.description: A reference to a part (vertex, edge or surface) of an analytical member. partId, customVertexData and ratioEdgeData are zero when left out.

elemGuid.description: The element of the analytical member.

ratioEdgeData.description: The part of the edge of a RatioEdge.

AnalyticalRigidityType.description: The rigidity of a degree of freedom of a release.

AnalyticalRelease.description: The release of an analytical member.

releaseDescriptions.description: The releases of the member parts. Each needs all six rigidities; a stiffness left out is 0.

AnalyticalCoordinateSystem.description: A local coordinate system, given by its X and Y axes.

AnalyticalCoordSysDirection.description: Whether the values are in the global or in the local coordinate system.

AnalyticalSupport.description: An analytical support: its settings and the member part it supports. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0.

supportValues.description: The rigidity and the value of the three translations and the three rotations.

AnalyticalSupportGeometry.description: The geometry of an analytical support in a Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalLink.description: An analytical link: its settings and the member parts it connects. The rigid and the spring settings are both required, whichever type the link has. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0 and a resistance left out is false.

AnalyticalLinkGeometry.description: The geometry of an analytical link in a Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalLoadForceType.description: Whether the load is a force or a moment.

AnalyticalPointLoad.description: An analytical point load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalEdgeLoad.description: An analytical edge load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

loadDistributionType.description: Whether the load is the same along the edge or changes from the start value to the end value.

AnalyticalSurfaceLoad.description: An analytical surface load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalEdgeLoadCustomData.description: The curve of an analytical edge load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.

AnalyticalSurfaceLoadCustomData.description: The contour of an analytical surface load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.

AnalyticalImportIdMapping.description: Maps the edges and vertices of the given surface member to the parts of the new element. Archicad 26 and newer.

AttributeCreationMethod.description: The creation method or workflow: AddOn (created by an Add-On), Merge (merging files), Paste (pasting from another file), New (created by the user through the UI), Import (an attribute file, IFC, DWG/DXF or another supported format), Explode (exploding a PDF or DWG), Duplicate (duplicating an attribute), Hotlink (a hotlinked file), XRef (a file attached in the Xref manager), Library (a library part), LibraryMaster (generated from GDL) or Unspecified.

IFCPropertyType.description: The kind of the IFC property.

IFCPropertySource.description: Where the property comes from: preview for the properties mapped by the preview IFC export translator, local for the IFC properties stored in the element. Available from Archicad 28.

ViewImageSource.description: The window whose image is returned: the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window.

HierarchicalOwnerMode.description: root: the root of the hierarchical element tree, e.g. the Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing. parent: the immediate parent, which may itself be a subelement.

PrinterPrintArea.description: The area Archicad prints, as set in the print settings. 'unknown' for a value this add-on does not name.

AttributePropertyDefinitionFilter.description: Which property definitions to return: the user defined (custom) ones, the fundamental built-in ones, or all of them.

LayoutInsertionPosition.description: Position of a new layout among its parent's children.

MEPRoutingAnchor.description: The anchor point of the cross section, on a 3x3 grid.

PartialStructureDisplay.description: The Partial Structure Display mode of the current window.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

DatabaseByWindowType.description: Selects a database by window type; a database ID may also be supplied.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

DatabaseById.description: Selects a database by ID; a window type may also be supplied.

DetailsOfElement.description: Details of an element. When the optional fields filter is given in the input, only the requested fields are present; the required list below applies to unfiltered requests.

elementId.description: The identifier of the element. Returned when elementId is listed in fields, and always when no elements are given.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink; such elements are read-only.

floorPlanPolygons.description: Cut-fill polygons as drawn on the floor plan (wall joins resolved by ArchiCAD). Only collected for construction element types whose floor plan symbol comes from a real cut through the element - walls, columns, beams and their segments, slabs, roofs, shells, meshes, morphs, curtain walls and their segments/panels/frames, stairs and their risers/treads/structures. Absent for every other type, when the element has no cut fill, or when the floor plan database is not accessible.

infoString.description: The element ID (info string) as Archicad shows it. Present only when requested in additionalFields.

compoundInfoString.description: The compound info string of the element, e.g. the summary of its composite or profile, as Archicad shows it. Present only when requested in additionalFields and the element has a non-empty one.

libraryPartUnId.description: The unique ID of the library part the element was placed from. Present only when requested in additionalFields and the element is library part based (e.g. object, lamp, door, window).

creatorToolUnId.description: The unique ID of the tool that created the element. Present only when requested in additionalFields and Archicad reports one for the element.

CutPlane.description: Defines a 3D cut plane using the plane equation: pa*x + pb*y + pc*z + pd = 0

pa.description: Coefficient of x in the plane equation. The x coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pb.description: Coefficient of y in the plane equation. The y coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pc.description: Coefficient of z in the plane equation. The z coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pd.description: Constant term in the plane equation, in meters. The distance of the plane from the origin along the normal vector.

elementId.description: A window or door placed in a wall.

coreOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the core skin of the owner wall, to convert to the wall side reference.

sideOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the side of the owner wall, to convert to the core skin reference.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to copy.

designOptions.description: The design options to turn off in the combination. The other options of the combination are left as they are.

name.description: The name of the Favorite.

elementType.description: The element type of the Favorite. Missing when Archicad cannot read the Favorite's element settings.

folder.description: The names of the folders leading from the root of the Favorites palette to the Favorite's folder. Returned only by SearchFavorites, and missing for a Favorite in the root folder.

type.description: The type of the database.

name.description: The name of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

referenceId.description: The reference id of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

name.description: The localized name of the category, for display only.

values.description: The possible values of the category.

name.description: The name of the rule. Rule names are unique within the project.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group to search the rule in. Left out: every rule group is searched.

name.description: The name of the project data.

guid.description: The identifier of the add-on object that stores the project data.

clientOnly.description: True when the project data is kept on this client only and is not shared in Teamwork.

teamworkOwner.description: The Teamwork user who has reserved the project data. Omitted when nobody has reserved it or the project is not a Teamwork project.

customSchemeKey.description: The identifier of the custom field. The same key is used in the customSchemeData of the revision changes.

customSchemeName.description: The name of the custom field.

userName.description: The login name of the user.

isConnected.description: Whether the user has joined the project.

mirrorAxis.description: The mirror axis: the line through two points on the floor plan.

beginPoint.description: First point of the mirror axis.

endPoint.description: Second point of the mirror axis. Must differ from beginPoint.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, a mirrored copy of the element is created and the original is kept. By default it's false.

ruleGroupName.description: The rule group the rule is moved to; it can be the rule's own group to change its place there. Created when no rule group has this name.

beforeGraphicOverrideRuleId.description: The rule of the target group the moved rule is put in front of. Left out: the rule becomes the last of the group.

propertySetName.description: The name of the property set, for example Pset_DoorCommon.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

path.description: The names of the folders from the root folder down to the folder to rename, the root folder itself not included.

newName.description: The new name of the folder.

name.description: The current name of the rule group.

newName.description: The new name of the rule group. It must not be empty or used by another rule group.

name.description: The name of the project data.

categoryValueId.description: A value of the category given by type, as GetElementCategories lists them.

name.description: The name of the IFC attribute, for example Name, Description, ObjectType or Tag. It must be one of the attributes GetIFCAttributesOfElements returns for the element.

value.description: The new value of the IFC attribute.

name.description: The name of the project data.

content.description: The content of the project data, for example a JSON string.

clientOnly.description: Creates the project data on this client only, it is not shared in Teamwork. Used only when the project data is created. The default is false.

unique.description: Creates the project data as a unique add-on object: in Teamwork only one can exist with its name, even when several users create it at the same time. Used only when the project data is created, and cannot be combined with clientOnly. The default is false.

StairBaselineData.description: The parameters of the Stair to check. Fields that are not given come from the current Stair tool defaults, as in CreateStairs.

baseLinePoints.description: 2D coordinates of the stair baseline polyline. Whether the baseline runs along the left edge, the right edge or the center of the flight is the Stair tool's baseline position, taken from the Stair tool defaults: with the baseline on the left edge, the flight lies to the right of it, looking from the first point to the last. The first point is kept; the length of the flight comes from the riser count and going, so the flight does not necessarily end at the last point given. Minimum 2 points for a straight stair, 3+ for L-shaped or U-shaped stairs.

zCoordinate.description: The Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the stair base.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from zCoordinate.

finishVisible.description: Optional. If false, the tread/riser finishes are hidden and only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is modeled.

coreOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the core skin of the owner wall.

sideOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the side of the owner wall.

links.description: The links starting from the element.

name.description: The name of the 3D style, unique within the project.

engineId.description: The id of the 3D rendering engine (API_3DStyle.engineId).

model3D.description: The 3D model type: Block, Wireframe, Hidden Line or Shading, as the integer value of API_3DModelTypeID.

monochromeEnabled.description: The model is shown in monochrome colors.

monochromeSurfaceColor.description: The surface color of the monochrome model.

monochromeContourColor.description: The contour color of the monochrome model.

backgroundAsInRendering.description: The background is the same as in the rendering settings.

chainBackgroundColors.description: The sky and the ground background colors are chained.

backgroundSkyColor.description: The sky color of the background (API_3DStyle.bkgSkyColor).

shadingContours.description: The contours in shaded mode, as the integer value of API_ShadingContoursID.

vectorialSunShadow.description: The vectorial sun shadow options, as the integer value of API_VectorShadowID.

contourThickness.description: The thickness of the contours, in pixels.

silhouetteThickness.description: The thickness of the silhouettes, in pixels.

vectorialHatchingThickness.description: The thickness of the vectorial hatching, in pixels.

shadowContourThickness.description: The thickness of the shadow contours, in pixels.

castShadowPercent.description: The intensity of the cast shadows, in percent.

shadingPercent.description: The intensity of the shading, in percent.

shadowElevation.description: The elevation of the shadow plane, used by the one level vectorial sun shadow options.

attributesByType.description: One item per requested attribute type, in the order of attributeTypes.

name.description: The name of the database (for example the name of the layout). Empty for databases without a name, like the floor plan.

contentBox.description: The full boundary box of the Drawing's content, independent of its frame, as returned by Archicad.

elementSets.description: The element sets that contain the element. Empty if the element is not part of any element set.

elementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

name.description: The name of the element type in the language of the running Archicad (for example "Wand" for Wall in German Archicad).

folder.description: The folder hierarchy of the Favorite in the Favorites palette. Empty for the root.

libPart.description: The library part of the Favorite, for the library part based types (Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone). Absent otherwise or when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters stored with the Favorite. Empty for the types without GDL parameters.

marker.description: The marker stored with a Window or Door Favorite. Absent when the Favorite has no marker - that is not an error.

libPart.description: The library part of the marker. Absent when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the marker.

subElements.description: The sub-elements stored with the Favorite.

fontIndex.description: Index of the font (from 1), as Text and Label fields reference it in fontIndex.

fontName.description: Name of the font as Archicad carries it.

ownerElementId.description: The owner element. For a main element (e.g. a Curtain Wall) or an element that is not part of a hierarchical element, Archicad returns the input element itself.

hierarchicalElementType.description: The classification of the input element (not of its owner): MainElement is the main element of a hierarchical element (e.g. a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing), ChildElement is a subelement of one (e.g. a frame or a tread), SingleElement is not part of a hierarchical element.

proxyElements.description: The proxy elements of the instance, in no particular order.

navigatorItemId.description: The Project Map item of the new database, for ChangeWindow or CreateDrawings. Missing when the item could not be found.

begC.description: The start point of the line, in layout coordinates.

endC.description: The end point of the line, in layout coordinates.

penIndex.description: The index of the pen of the line.

lineTypeIndex.description: The index of the line type of the line.

Document3DPlanConnection.description: The connection of the 3D Document to the model.

Document3DBoundaryDisplay.description: How the boundary contours are displayed.

Document3DAttributeOptions.description: The uniform attribute options (cut and uncut surfaces, shading, hidden edges).

shouldUseUniformCutAttributes.description: Use uniform attributes on the cut surfaces.

uniformLineType.description: The index of the uniform line type of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillPen.description: The uniform fill pen of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillBkgPen.description: The uniform fill background pen of the cut surfaces.

uncutSurfaceBkgPen.description: The background pen of the uncut surfaces.

shouldUseElemPen.description: Use a uniform pen for the element contours.

elemPen.description: The uniform pen of the element contours.

shadFillPen.description: The pen of the shadow fill.

shadFill.description: The index of the shadow fill.

shadFillBkgPen.description: The background pen of the shadow fill.

shadContPen.description: The pen of the shadow contours.

hiddenEdgeLineType.description: The index of the line type of the hidden edges.

hiddenEdgeLinePen.description: The pen of the hidden edges.

type.description: The API_PrimTypeID name without its API_Prim prefix and ID suffix.

pen.description: The pen index of the primitive.

lineType.description: Line, Arc, PLine, Tri and Poly: the line type.

determination.description: How the type of the line or fill is determined (origin, inner line, contour line).

loc.description: Point: the location. Text: the left baseline position.

nArcs.description: The number of curved segments. Their geometry is not returned.

polygons.description: Poly: the sub polygons, the first one is the outline, the others are holes.

destBox.description: Pict: the bounding box of the picture.

referencedElement.description: Ctrl_ElementRef: the element the item refers to. The drawing of a Wall ends with one such item for each Window and Door in it.

drwIndex.description: The drawing order index of the referenced element.

primitives.description: The primitives in the order Archicad draws them. The Ctrl_* items mark the beginning and the end of sub-parts (hatch borders, hatch lines, texts, curtain wall panels, ...).

name.description: The name of the parent navigator item.

keyword.description: The keyword of the note autotext.

name.description: The name of the project data.

content.description: The content of the project data.

reservedBy.description: The user who has reserved the element. Left out when the element is free.

owner.description: The Teamwork owner of the element. In Teamwork the owner is the user who has reserved the element, so this is the same user as reservedBy; kept for compatibility. Left out when the element is free.

surfaces.description: The surfaces of the element as Archicad reports them: one item per surface attribute and building material pair of the element, so an element has as many items as it has distinct pairs (a basic wall with three different surfaces reports three items). Empty when Archicad reports no surface for the element, for example for an element without a 3D model.

reductions.description: The reduction polygons of the Zone, as its Zone Stamp's area calculation uses them: the parts of the Zone polygon covered by Walls, Columns and reducing Fills, and the parts under a low ceiling (for example under a sloping Roof), each with the percentage it is reduced by and its area. Empty when nothing reduces the Zone's area.

length.description: The length of the longest line.

longestLineIndex.description: The zero-based index of the longest line (the first of them on a tie).

lineLengths.description: The length of every line, in order. An empty line is 0.

capitalSizeFactor.description: The ratio of the font's capital size to its typographic size. Absent when Archicad does not return it for the font.

polygons.description: The valid polygons Archicad made of the input: none, one or more.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the regularized polyline. Empty when nothing valid is left of it.

arcs.description: The arcs of the regularized polyline.

baseLinePoints.description: The baseline polyline after the solver ran.

baseLineArcs.description: The arcs of the baseline after the solver ran, indexing baseLinePoints. Present only when the baseline has arcs.

totalHeight.description: Total height of the stair after the solver ran.

flightWidth.description: Width of the stair flight after the solver ran.

stepNum.description: Number of risers after the solver ran.

riserHeight.description: Height of each riser after the solver ran.

treadDepth.description: Depth (going) of each tread after the solver ran.

triangles.description: The triangles covering the polygon of the element, holes excluded, as Archicad triangulates it.

vertices.description: The 2D coordinates of the three vertices of the triangle.

elementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: The flags stored on the link by LinkElements.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only.

isVisibleOnUI.description: The value is offered in the settings dialogs of Archicad.

usableAsCriteria.description: The value can be used as a criterion, for example in Find & Select and in Graphic Override rules.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only.

libPart.description: The library part of the sub-element. Absent when it has none or it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the sub-element.

proxyElementId.description: The proxy element in the current project.

sourceElementId.description: The element in the hotlink's source file the proxy was made from.

surfaceId.description: The surface (material) attribute of the surface. Left out when the surface is not a project attribute, for example one defined by a GDL script.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material of the part of the element the surface belongs to.

exposedArea.description: The area of the surface that is not covered by any of the covering elements, in square meters.

percent.description: The percentage by which the area of the polygon reduces the Zone area, as the DevKit reports it.

area.description: The area of the polygon in square meters.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline of the polygon in meters; the last coordinate repeats the first.

polygonArcs.description: The arcs of the outline, indices into polygonOutline. Absent when the outline has no arc.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline. A last coordinate equal to the first is ignored.
The 2D coordinates of the outline, without a closing coordinate.

PolygonAncestry.description: Read from the vertexAncestry and edgeAncestry of Archicad's API_RegularizedPoly; -1 marks a vertex or edge that Archicad created (for example at a self-intersection).

contours.description: One item per contour of this result: the outline first, then the holes in order.

vertices.description: For each vertex of the contour, the input vertex it came from.

edges.description: For each edge of the contour (edge i runs from vertex i to the next one), the input edge it came from.

PolygonVertexAncestry.description: An input vertex or edge: the contour (0 is the outline, k the hole at index k-1 of the request) and the vertex or edge in it (edge i runs from vertex i to the next one). Both are -1 when Archicad created it.

PolygonEdgeAncestry.description: An input vertex or edge: the contour (0 is the outline, k the hole at index k-1 of the request) and the vertex or edge in it (edge i runs from vertex i to the next one). Both are -1 when Archicad created it.

PolylineAncestry.description: Read from the vertexAncestry and edgeAncestry of Archicad's API_RegularizedPoly; -1 marks a vertex or edge that Archicad created (for example at a self-intersection).

vertices.description: For each point of the result, the index of the input point it came from.

edges.description: For each segment of the result (segment i runs from point i to point i+1), the index of the input segment it came from.

PolylineVertexAncestry.description: An input point or segment by its index (segment i runs from point i to point i+1); -1 when Archicad created it.

PolylineEdgeAncestry.description: An input point or segment by its index (segment i runs from point i to point i+1); -1 when Archicad created it.

ElementReservationState.description: Free: nobody has reserved the element. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see reservedBy).

ZoneReductionType.description: What reduces the area in the polygon, as the DevKit's APIRoomReduction type of the polygon: Wall, Column, Hatch (a Fill set to reduce the Zone area), Gable (a low ceiling, for example the part under a sloping Roof below the low ceiling height), or Rest (the remaining polygon of the Zone). Unknown for a value this version of Tapir does not name.

StairBaselineSolutionState.description: Correct: the baseline was already valid, nothing changed. Solved: the solver turned it into a valid baseline, returned in baseLinePoints. NotSolved: no valid baseline was found; CreateStairs is likely to fail or create an invalid stair with this input.

FavoriteSubelementType.description: MainMarker for the main marker of the element; Other for any other kind of sub-element.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for angle values.
Number of decimals to display for area values.
Number of decimals to display for volume values.

NameKind.description: The kind of an item of the project that ResolveNames looks a name up among: a story, an attribute of the given type, an element type (matched by its API name and, from Archicad 27, by the name the Archicad interface shows), a property (built-in or custom; matched by its name and by its group and name together), or a classification (a classification system, matched by its name and by its name and version together, or an item of any system at any depth, matched by its name, by its ID and by both together).

NameMatch.description: An item of the project that a name matches, as ResolveNames returns it.

name.description: The name of the item in the project. For an element type, the name the Archicad interface shows (from Archicad 27; the API name before). For a classification item, its name, or its ID when it has no name.

match.description: How the name matches. exact: the same characters. normalized: the same except for case, accents, spacing and separators (FireRating, fire_rating, Fire Rating). words: every word of one is a word of the other, or at least half of their words are shared. contains: one contains the other. similar: a few characters differ.

score.description: How close the match is, from 0.6 to 1 (1 for exact and normalized matches).

storyIndex.description: The index of the story (the floor index the commands take). Only for a story.

level.description: The level of the story, in meters. Only for a story.

attributeIndex.description: The index of the attribute. Only for an attribute.

propertyId.description: The property, as GetPropertyValuesOfElements and SetPropertyValuesOfElements take it. Only for a property.

propertyGroupId.description: The group of the property. Only for a property.

propertyGroupName.description: The name of the group of the property. Only for a property.

propertyType.description: Whether the property is built in or custom. Only for a property.

propertyCollectionType.description: Whether the property holds one value, a list, or one or more choices of a list of options. Only for a property.

propertyValueType.description: The type of the values of the property. Only for a property.

propertyMeasureType.description: What a number value of the property measures. Only for a property; left out for the attribute index types of some built-in properties.

propertyIsEditable.description: Whether the value of the property can be set. Only for a property.

availability.description: The classification items the property is available for: an element has the property only when it is classified as one of them. Only for a custom property; built-in properties have no such list.

classificationSystemId.description: The classification system, or the system of the classification item. Only for a classification.

classificationSystemName.description: The name of the classification system. Only for a classification.

classificationItemId.description: The classification item. Only for a classification item, not for a classification system.

classificationItemCode.description: The ID of the classification item, as Archicad shows it (for example Ss_25_10). Only for a classification item.

ElementHeaderFromOtherDatabase.description: An element that is not in the current database but in another one (a layout, a section, a worksheet ...). Only the fields of its element header are returned: no id, details or floorPlanPolygons. Use GetContainingDatabases and ChangeWindow to open its database and read its full details.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink.

fromOtherDatabase.description: Always true: the element is not in the current database.

infoString.description: The new Element ID, as the Info Box shows it (GetDetailsOfElements returns it as id).

transformation.description: The transformation chain of the library part instance: placement at location, rotation by angle, then scaling by xRatio and yRatio in the rotated coordinate system.

location.description: The location of the referenced library part on the floor plan.

angle.description: The rotation angle in radians.

xRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated x axis.

yRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated y axis.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's 3D model, including those of its subelements for a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of its segments for a Column or Beam. Empty when the element has no solid 3D model (for example a 2D element, or one filtered out of the 3D view).

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline of the hole, as Archicad returns them. The outline is closed implicitly (the first vertex is not repeated at the end); a curved edge is given by its end points only.

hasVisibleSkin.description: True when the element has at least one skin shown in the given Partial Structure Display mode.

convexPolygons.description: With convex: true, the convex polygons the faces of the element's 3D model are decomposed into, body by body and face by face. Empty (or an error item instead) when the element has no solid 3D model of its own (the bodies of a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of the segments of a Column or Beam, belong to their subelements, which can be given instead).

vertices.description: The 3D world coordinates of the vertices of the convex polygon, in order.

componentType.description: The component type: the API_3DTypeID enumerator name without its API_ prefix and ID suffix.

count.description: The number of components of this type.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's own 3D model, in Archicad's order, or an error for a body without texture information. Empty (or an error item instead) when the element has no solid 3D model of its own (the bodies of a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of the segments of a Column or Beam, belong to their subelements, which can be given instead).

polygons.description: One item per face of the body, in Archicad's order: the texture coordinates at the first vertex of the face, or an error.

point.description: The first vertex of the face, in world coordinates.

u.description: The u texture coordinate at the point.

v.description: The v texture coordinate at the point.

composites.description: The quantities per building material, in the order Archicad reports them: one item for each skin of a composite or complex profile element, and a single item for a basic element. Empty for Zones and Morphs, for which Archicad reports no skins.

projectedArea.description: Projected area of the skin. Archicad reports 0 when the legacy intersection and surface calculation is turned on in the Project Preferences.

isCore.description: The skin is marked as core.

isFinish.description: The skin is marked as finish.

subElementId.description: The sub-element (for example a column or beam segment) the skin belongs to. Present only when Archicad attaches the skin to a sub-element.

absoluteBottom.description: The absolute bottom level of the curtain wall or its subelement, as returned by ACAPI_CurtainWall_GetCWAbsoluteBottom.

elementId.description: A Text element or a Label of the Text class.

from.description: The position in the content where the replaced range starts.

range.description: The number of characters to replace; 0 inserts the content at 'from'. The range may not reach over a line end into another paragraph.

content.description: The new content of the range; an empty string deletes the range. It must not contain line ends.

SectionElevationSettableDetails.description: The settings of a Section or Elevation element (API_SectionSegment / API_CutPlaneType), apart from its name and reference ID. Shared by CreateSections, CreateElevations and SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails; all fields are optional. The name and the reference ID are the name and id fields of CreateSections and CreateElevations, and ModifySections changes them on existing elements.

linePenIndex.description: Pen index of the section/elevation line.

textPenIndex.description: Pen index of the marker text.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the section/elevation line.

sectionLinePenIndex.description: Pen index used for cut contours (when useElementPens is false).

sectionFillPenIndex.description: Pen index used for cut fills (when useElementPens is false).

sectionFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Background pen index of the cut fills (when useElementPens is false).

verticalRange.description: Vertical range of the segment. FitToZoneRange is for interior elevations only.

verticalRangeStoryBaseNumber.description: The story vertMin/vertMax are relative to, when relativeToStory is true.

relativeToStory.description: Vertical limited range is relative to the home story (true) or absolute to project zero (false).

showMarkerAtBeginning.description: Put marker on the beginning point.

showMarkerAtEnd.description: Put marker on the end point.

useElementPens.description: Use the pens defined in the cut elements instead of sectionLinePenIndex/sectionFillPenIndex/sectionFillBackgroundPenIndex.

showLineAtBeginning.description: Show line at the beginning point.

showLineAtMiddle.description: Show line at the middle point.

showLineAtEnd.description: Show line at the end point.

textSize.description: Text size [mm] of the marker text.

fontIndex.description: Font index of the marker text.

effectSunFrom3D.description: Use the same Sun parameters as in the 3D window.

shadowFillId.description: Fill attribute of the shadow's fill.

shadowFillPenIndex.description: Pen index of the shadow's fill.

shadowFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Background pen index of the shadow's fill.

limitLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the horizontal limit line.

limitLinePenIndex.description: Pen index of the horizontal limit line.

continuous.description: Continuous line if true, otherwise segmented.

sunAzimuth.description: Custom sun azimuth relative to the cut plane.

sunAltitude.description: Custom sun altitude relative to the cut plane.

useOneModelPen.description: Use one pen for all elements in the Section/Elevation view (Model Effects).

modelPenIndex.description: Foreground pen of model uncut surface fill.

modelUncutSurfaceFillType.description: Method for displaying fills of uncut surfaces (Model Effects), effective if useUncutSurfaceFill is true.

modelUncutSurfaceFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Pencolor for uncut surface fills (Model Effects) if a uniform pencolor is selected.

useUncutSurfaceFill.description: Apply fills to uncut surfaces displayed in the Section/Elevation (Model Effects).

useOneDistantAreaPen.description: Use one pen for all elements in the distant area.

distantAreaPenIndex.description: Pen index of elements in the distant area.

distantAreaUncutSurfaceFillBackgroundPen.description: Pencolor for uncut surface fills in the distant area if a uniform pencolor is selected.

useUncutSurfaceFillInDistantArea.description: Apply fills to uncut surfaces displayed in the distant area.

storyHandleAppearance.description: Options for displaying story lines on the Section/Elevation.

storyHandleLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the Story Level lines.

storyHandleLinePenIndex.description: Pencolor index of the Story Level lines.

storyHandleMarkerPenIndex.description: Pencolor index of the Story Handle Markers (when not overridden by storyHandleUseSymbolPens).

storyHandleUseSymbolPens.description: Use the Story Handle Marker object's own colors instead of storyHandleMarkerPenIndex.

storyHandleLeftMarkerVisible.description: Display the Story Handle Markers on the left side.

storyHandleRightMarkerVisible.description: Display the Story Handle Markers on the right side.

storyHandleLineVisible.description: Story handle line is on or off.

storyHandleLeftMarkerOffset.description: Offset of the Story Level line beyond the limits of the Section/Elevation, left side.

storyHandleRightMarkerOffset.description: Offset of the Story Level line beyond the limits of the Section/Elevation, right side.

storyHandleMarkerFontIndex.description: Font index of the Story Handle Marker.

storyHandleMarkerTextSize.description: Text size [mm] of the Story Handle Marker.

storyHandleMarkerSize.description: Size [mm] of the Story Handle Marker.

boundaryLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the boundary contour.

showOnStories.description: Which stories to show the cut plane on.

storyToShowOn.description: Story index to show the cut plane on, if showOnStories is 'OneStory'.

markerShowType.description: Show side (wing) markers or a single middle marker.

intendedPlanConnectivity.description: Intended plan connectivity: whether the Section/Elevation is automatically rebuilt from the model (Online), rebuilt only on demand (Offline), or exploded into unlinked 2D drawing elements (Drawing).

SectionElevationDetails.description: Full readable state of a Section or Elevation element: every field of SectionElevationSettableDetails, plus its name and reference ID and read-only/informational fields.

name.description: Name of the section/elevation, shown in the Project Map. ModifySections changes it.

id.description: The reference ID shown in the marker and in the Project Map. If it contains a '/' character, the text is split between the beginning and end marks. ModifySections changes it.

linePenIndex.description: Pen index of the section/elevation line.

textPenIndex.description: Pen index of the marker text.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the section/elevation line.

sectionLinePenIndex.description: Pen index used for cut contours (when useElementPens is false).

sectionFillPenIndex.description: Pen index used for cut fills (when useElementPens is false).

sectionFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Background pen index of the cut fills (when useElementPens is false).

verticalRange.description: Vertical range of the segment. FitToZoneRange is for interior elevations only.

verticalRangeStoryBaseNumber.description: The story vertMin/vertMax are relative to, when relativeToStory is true.

relativeToStory.description: Vertical limited range is relative to the home story (true) or absolute to project zero (false).

showMarkerAtBeginning.description: Put marker on the beginning point.

showMarkerAtEnd.description: Put marker on the end point.

useElementPens.description: Use the pens defined in the cut elements instead of sectionLinePenIndex/sectionFillPenIndex/sectionFillBackgroundPenIndex.

showLineAtBeginning.description: Show line at the beginning point.

showLineAtMiddle.description: Show line at the middle point.

showLineAtEnd.description: Show line at the end point.

textSize.description: Text size [mm] of the marker text.

fontIndex.description: Font index of the marker text.

effectSunFrom3D.description: Use the same Sun parameters as in the 3D window.

shadowFillId.description: Fill attribute of the shadow's fill.

shadowFillPenIndex.description: Pen index of the shadow's fill.

shadowFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Background pen index of the shadow's fill.

limitLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the horizontal limit line.

limitLinePenIndex.description: Pen index of the horizontal limit line.

continuous.description: Continuous line if true, otherwise segmented.

sunAzimuth.description: Custom sun azimuth relative to the cut plane.

sunAltitude.description: Custom sun altitude relative to the cut plane.

useOneModelPen.description: Use one pen for all elements in the Section/Elevation view (Model Effects).

modelPenIndex.description: Foreground pen of model uncut surface fill.

modelUncutSurfaceFillType.description: Method for displaying fills of uncut surfaces (Model Effects), effective if useUncutSurfaceFill is true.

modelUncutSurfaceFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Pencolor for uncut surface fills (Model Effects) if a uniform pencolor is selected.

useUncutSurfaceFill.description: Apply fills to uncut surfaces displayed in the Section/Elevation (Model Effects).

useOneDistantAreaPen.description: Use one pen for all elements in the distant area.

distantAreaPenIndex.description: Pen index of elements in the distant area.

distantAreaUncutSurfaceFillBackgroundPen.description: Pencolor for uncut surface fills in the distant area if a uniform pencolor is selected.

useUncutSurfaceFillInDistantArea.description: Apply fills to uncut surfaces displayed in the distant area.

storyHandleAppearance.description: Options for displaying story lines on the Section/Elevation.

storyHandleLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the Story Level lines.

storyHandleLinePenIndex.description: Pencolor index of the Story Level lines.

storyHandleMarkerPenIndex.description: Pencolor index of the Story Handle Markers (when not overridden by storyHandleUseSymbolPens).

storyHandleUseSymbolPens.description: Use the Story Handle Marker object's own colors instead of storyHandleMarkerPenIndex.

storyHandleLeftMarkerVisible.description: Display the Story Handle Markers on the left side.

storyHandleRightMarkerVisible.description: Display the Story Handle Markers on the right side.

storyHandleLineVisible.description: Story handle line is on or off.

storyHandleLeftMarkerOffset.description: Offset of the Story Level line beyond the limits of the Section/Elevation, left side.

storyHandleRightMarkerOffset.description: Offset of the Story Level line beyond the limits of the Section/Elevation, right side.

storyHandleMarkerFontIndex.description: Font index of the Story Handle Marker.

storyHandleMarkerTextSize.description: Text size [mm] of the Story Handle Marker.

storyHandleMarkerSize.description: Size [mm] of the Story Handle Marker.

boundaryLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the boundary contour.

showOnStories.description: Which stories to show the cut plane on.

storyToShowOn.description: Story index to show the cut plane on, if showOnStories is 'OneStory'.

markerShowType.description: Show side (wing) markers or a single middle marker.

intendedPlanConnectivity.description: Intended plan connectivity: whether the Section/Elevation is automatically rebuilt from the model (Online), rebuilt only on demand (Offline), or exploded into unlinked 2D drawing elements (Drawing).

distantAreaShadowFillId.description: Read-only: fill attribute for shadow polygons in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: this always mirrors shadowFillId and cannot be set independently through the API (ACAPI_Element_CreateExt/ACAPI_Element_Change silently ignore an explicit value here and copy it from shadowFillId instead).

distantAreaShadowFillPenIndex.description: Read-only: fill pen index for shadow polygons in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: always mirrors shadowFillPenIndex, cannot be set independently (see distantAreaShadowFillId).

distantAreaShadowFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Read-only: fill background pen index for shadow polygons in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: always mirrors shadowFillBackgroundPenIndex, cannot be set independently (see distantAreaShadowFillId).

distantAreaUncutSurfaceFillType.description: Read-only: method for displaying fills of uncut surfaces in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: cannot be set independently through the API, always reads back as PenColor regardless of the value written (see distantAreaShadowFillId).

currentPlanConnectivity.description: Read-only: current plan connectivity state of the open Section/Elevation window.

isWindowOpened.description: Read-only: whether the Section/Elevation window is currently opened.

isActive.description: Read-only: whether the segment is turned off or active.

isSourceMarker.description: Read-only: whether this segment is a source marker.

isInDrawingMode.description: Read-only: whether the section is in drawing mode.

beginMarkerElementId.description: Read-only: the Section Marker object at the starting point of the section line.

middleMarkerElementId.description: Read-only: the Section Marker object at the center point of the section line.

endMarkerElementId.description: Read-only: the Section Marker object at the end point of the section line.
